run_inference_on_image: run inference on a single image using detectron models and output a visualization PDF
run_rpn_box_proposals: run RPN box proposals on an image using a specified RPN model and config file
run_multiple_models: run multiple detectron models in sequence on an image with pkl and yaml config pairs
parse_inference_args: parse command line arguments for image inference including model paths and output directory
check_inference_args: check and validate inference arguments ensuring RPN files and model config pairs exist
